blocking: The hero logo and descriptor remain invisible if canopy.js fails to load: site.js enables .anim-ready, but only canopy.js reveals .hero__rise.
Hero text clearance is not preserved during scrolling: site.js moves the mark downward immediately, while canopy.js delays its protective fade until 25% of the hero has scrolled.

fixes.what: Keep .hero__rise visible by default. Set its initial opacity inside the same GSAP context that creates its entrance animation; restore visibility on initialization failure.
fixes.why: A failed optional animation script must never remove the business identity and introductory copy.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js: buildTweens() block 1; assets/js/canopy.js: buildAll() block 3
fixes.what: Give canopy.js sole ownership of the home hero movement and fade. Finish the fade before the translated text bounds reach the painted canopy, using measured geometry instead of fixed 25%–65% thresholds.
fixes.why: The downward translation consumes the initial artwork clearance before the current fade starts.

fixes.what: Gate every video start on document visibility and actual hero visibility; include both viewport bounds and computed display state. Retain these checks inside the IntersectionObserver callback.
fixes.why: An observer or load callback can restart playback while the tab is hidden; checking only bottom > 0 is insufficient.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css: .site-footer address > span; header sizing rules
fixes.what: Allow the footer location line to wrap and add a narrow-width header layout that lets flex items shrink without clipping. Verify at 320 CSS pixels and with enlarged text.
fixes.why: The footer's forced nowrap and fixed header item widths make reflow fragile; the clean 390px harness result does not cover these cases.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js and assets/css/site.css: obsolete accordion, descend, journey and teaser implementations
fixes.what: Remove unused implementations after checking selectors across the four pages, and consolidate the remaining hero logic with canopy.js.
fixes.why: Large dormant components and overlapping animation ownership make this small static site unnecessarily difficult to maintain and regression-test.
